candidates.name: label_aware
candidates.hypothesis: Combining structured label indicator words with a smaller set of representative examples per label will provide the model enough context to understand the label space efficiently, reducing cost while maintaining or improving accuracy.

candidates.name: similarity_select
candidates.hypothesis: Retrieving only the top-K examples most similar to the input will dramatically reduce context cost while preserving accuracy, since examples most similar to the current input are more likely to be useful for prediction.

candidates.name: adaptive_topk
candidates.hypothesis: Constraining the label space via Options list allows fewer examples; adapting TOP_K to input structure (K=8 with Options, K=15 without) reduces cost while maintaining accuracy.

candidates.name: recency_feedback
candidates.hypothesis: Blending input similarity with recency (preferring newer examples in memory) and success feedback (examples whose labels matched recent correct predictions) creates implicit learning that improves accuracy without explicit label modeling.
